summary: Frontend testing of Multi-User System Phase 2-5: Gestión de Usuarios page, usePermissions hook, mobile optimization, and stability components. All requested features verified working correctly.
passed_tests: GestionUsuariosPage loads correctly for business owner (elite.nails@test.com)
User creation modal shows complete form (nombre, email, password, telefono, especialidad, comision)
Role selector works correctly - displays 'Administrador (20 permisos)' and 'Empleado (8 permisos)'
Custom permissions toggle and permission checkboxes functional
User list displays existing sub-users with roles, emails, phone, last access
Stats cards show accurate counts (Total Usuarios, Activos, Admins, Empleados)
Comercio bottom navigation visible on mobile (<1024px viewport)
All 5 bottom nav items found: Inicio, Agenda, Cotizar (primary), Clientes, Facturar
AgendaPage shows mobile list view on mobile viewport (md:hidden)
AgendaPage shows desktop grid view on desktop viewport (hidden md:block)
Mobile agenda shows day cards with appointment list format
ClientesPage shows card layout on mobile (md:hidden)
ClientesPage shows table layout on desktop (hidden md:block)
usePermissions hook working - canManageUsers() returns true for owner
usePermissions hook working - employee redirected when accessing /gestion-usuarios
Gestión dropdown menu shows 'Usuarios' link for business owner
ErrorBoundary wraps entire application in App.js
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-User System Phases 2-5 completed. Phase 2: GestionUsuariosPage allows owner to create/edit/manage sub-users with roles. Phase 3: usePermissions hook provides RBAC checks (hasPermission, canManageUsers, etc). ProtectedAction component hides/disables elements based on permissions. Phase 4: Mobile optimization includes comercioBottomNav (visible <1024px), AgendaPage mobile list view, ClientesPage/ProductosPage responsive cards/table. Phase 5: ErrorBoundary wraps entire app, GlobalLoader components exist, useDebounce hook available.
